## Introduction

## Plot

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| fig-cap: "Bond Films' Revenue"
#| label: fig-bond

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise'] == "James Bond"]


plt.plot(bond['year'], films['revenue_musd'}

firstyr = min(bond['year'])
lastyr = max(bond['year'])
```

The first Bond year is '{python} int(firstyr)'. The last Bond year is '{python} int(lastyr)'.
